easyPrerequisites: Elvish Aberration doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, targeting Elvish Aberration.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Staff of Domination's ability, targeting Elvish Aberration.
Resolve the first Staff of Domination ability, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Holding priority, activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Resolve the second Staff of Domination ability, untapping Elvish Aberration.
Activate Elvish Aberration by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
